description: The original defect restored: 'ai business coach' is a GSC row whose search_volume was overwritten with its own 5-impression count and given GSC provenance, it still carries the removed `volume` key, and it is banded measured_search_volume so it sorts as a peer of real market-volume rows. This is the 22x mis-scoring VAL-116 was admitted to refuse.

data/authority_scale/query_atlas.json.unit_contract: search_volume is modelled monthly market volume; impressions_90d is this domain's own 90-day count.

rank_scoring.formula: band-major, then demand desc within band
